nights.title: 9th Wonder
nights.name: 9th Wonder
nights.extract: Patrick Denard Douthit, better known as 9th Wonder, is an American record producer, record executive, educator, and DJ who is the CEO of Jamla Records, distributed and marketed by Roc Nation, and Empire Distribution. As of Fall 2022, Douthit is Professor of the Practice in Residence in the Program in African American Studies at Wake Forest University. He also continues to teach courses at Duke University alongside his longtime collaborator, Professor Mark Anthony Neal.

de.kicker: amerikanischer produzent · CEO von Jamla Records
de.who: Patrick Denard Douthit, bekannt als 9th Wonder, ist ein amerikanischer Musikproduzent, Plattenmanager, Pädagoge und DJ. Er ist CEO von Jamla Records, das von Roc Nation und Empire Distribution vertrieben und vermarktet wird.
facts: Seit Herbst 2022 ist Douthit Professor of the Practice in Residence im Programm für Afroamerikanische Studien an der Wake Forest University.
Er unterrichtet außerdem weiterhin an der Duke University, zusammen mit seinem langjährigen Mitarbeiter Professor Mark Anthony Neal.

tr.kicker: amerikalı müzik yapımcısı · Jamla Records CEO'su
tr.who: Patrick Denard Douthit, 9th Wonder adıyla tanınan Amerikalı bir müzik yapımcısı, plak yöneticisi, eğitimci ve DJ'dir. Jamla Records'un CEO'sudur ve plak şirketi Roc Nation ile Empire Distribution tarafından dağıtılıp pazarlanıyor.
facts: 2022 sonbaharından beri Douthit, Wake Forest Üniversitesi'nde Afrika Amerikan Çalışmaları programında Professor of the Practice in Residence unvanını taşıyor.
Duke Üniversitesi'nde uzun süredir birlikte çalıştığı Profesör Mark Anthony Neal ile ders vermeyi sürdürüyor.

nights.name: Enter Shikari
nights.extract: Enter Shikari are an English rock band formed in St Albans, Hertfordshire in 1999 by bassist Chris Batten, lead vocalist and keyboardist Rou Reynolds, and drummer Rob Rolfe. In 2003, guitarist Rory Clewlow joined the band to complete its current line-up, and it adopted its current name.

nights.title: Look Mum No Computer
nights.name: Look Mum No Computer
nights.extract: Sam James Bartle, known by the stage names Sam Battle and Look Mum No Computer, is an English musician, YouTuber, electronics enthusiast, and composer. He posts videos about making pro audio equipment and synthesisers, as well as original music.
